text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During a performance, we hear students in the crowd saying that concerts are only for star runners—for those who earn their mics on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon counters, arguing that every runner has emotions she wants to convey to fans in her own voice, regardless of how she placed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why we're creating a space just for that—the pure expression of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Falcon's impassioned plea, even students who previously showed no interest in our project begin to warm up to the idea of the Grand Concert.
